ops.title: PR269: reject invalid repository signatures during discovery
ops.description: Owner: Yasyf Mohamedali <yasyf@poetic.com>. Next: validate HEAD contents and the resolved common directory signatures before accepting a candidate, or decline. Evidence: internal/gitcmd/discover.go:113; /Users/yasyf/.vcache/scratch/ccn-write-floor-review/pr269-_qireoxt/discovery-results.txt:6 and :10. The nested invalid HEAD selects a different repository than Git; an empty commondir is accepted while Git rejects it.

ops.text: A nested invalid HEAD and an invalid commondir both decline; Dirs matches Git for the nearest valid repository or its rejection.
